posts.title: The Dopamine Transfer Deficit: Why Traditional Planners Freeze ADHD Brains
posts.excerpt: When dopamine anticipatory signals don't fire predictably, standard to-do lists trigger cognitive paralysis. Here is what neuroscience says about the gap between intention and action.

author.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
author.bio: Cognitive neuroscientist researching executive dysfunction and anticipatory dopamine signaling in adult ADHD.

posts.title: Building LOAH: The Zero Activation Energy Architecture
posts.excerpt: If opening an app requires more than 1 tap and 3 seconds of working memory, the ADHD brain will abandon it by Day 3. Inside our design principles for radical simplicity.

author.name: Kiran Vance
author.bio: Systems architect diagnosed with ADHD in adulthood. Obsessed with reducing UI initiation friction.

posts.title: Time Blindness vs. Time Blocking: Why Strict Schedules Cause Shame Spirals
posts.excerpt: Calendar-blocking works for neurotypical brains because their sense of future time is continuous. For ADHD brains, time is binary: 'Now' or 'Not Now.'

author.name: Maya Lin
author.bio: Product strategist living with combined-type ADHD, exploring gentle productivity systems.
